office: the municipal offices of municipalities with extended powers (in Prague, the city district offices 1 to 22), and the Ministry of the Interior for reduced periods

urgent.service: within 24 hours of a working day, collected at the Ministry of the Interior

note: Collecting a 30-day passport at another authority than the one applied to costs CZK 100 more. A reduced-period application at a municipal authority with collection at the Ministry is paid in two parts (CZK 4,000 and 2,000 for 24 hours; 2,000 and 1,000 for 5 working days).

sources.title: portal.gov.cz, Issue of a passport
sources.said: The passport is issued with territorial validity in all countries of the world and with a validity of 5 years for citizens under the age of 15, or 10 years for citizens over the age of 15 ... You can apply for a passport: at any municipal office of a municipality with extended powers, in Prague, at any office of city districts 1 to 22, in the case of a passport being issued within 30 days, or within reduced periods of 24 hours on a working day or within 5 working days, at the Ministry of the Interior ... when abroad, at an embassy ... In this case, it shall be issued within 120 days ... For a passport to be issued within 30 days: The administrative fee is CZK 600, and CZK 100 for a citizen under the age of 15 ... An administrative fee of CZK 100 is payable for collecting your passport if you collect a passport issued within 30 days at an authority other than the one to which you applied ... For a passport issued in a reduced period of up to 24 hours on a working day: for submission and collection at the Ministry of the Interior CZK 6 000, for submission at a municipal authority with extended powers CZK 4,000, and collection at the Ministry of the Interior CZK 2,000, for citizens under the age of 15: for submission and collection at the Ministry of the Interior CZK 2 000 ... For a passport issued in a reduced period of up to 5 working days: for submission and collection at the Ministry of the Interior CZK 3 000 ... for citizens under the age of 15: for submission and collection at the Ministry of the Interior CZK 1 000
